verdict.rationale: Featurebase documents an API reference, SDK, and webhooks (developers.featurebase.app), showing a real API surface exists, but there is no evidence claiming or demonstrating full feature parity between the UI and API — no OpenAPI spec was found (404s on all candidate paths), and admin/workflow/changelog features are described only as UI capabilities. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation, published OpenAPI spec, and evidence that UI-only features (workflows, changelog widgets, integrations) are also exposed via API.
